segments.text: IF WE WERE -- AGAIN, I THINK THERE IS THAT TYPE OF VERBIAGE CHANGES DE MINIMIS AND PROBABLY WOULD FALL WITHIN OUR ABILITY IF WE HAD AN AGREEMENT. MS. TRAVIS, I UNDERSTAND FOR THE RECORD THAT YOU'RE AUTHORIZED TO MAKE THAT CHANGE AND YOU'RE IN AGREEMENT FOR THE RAYS ORGANIZATION?

segments.text: AND THEN ALSO, YOU MENTIONED IT ALREADY, BUT THE RETURNING CITIZENS WORKFORCE REENTRY, I'M VERY HAPPY THAT THAT IS IN THERE. THANK YOU. I THINK THAT'S GOING TO BE GREAT OPPORTUNITIES FOR PEOPLE THAT ARE RETURNING. THANK YOU FOR MAKING SURE THAT WAS IN THERE.

segments.text: THE $200,000 FOR TPD, THAT IS THERE FOR NEW TAMPA -- AGAIN, THESE ARE FUNDS THAT I ADVOCATED FOR. I'LL STATE LATER WHY I'M DOING THIS, IF THIS GETS A WELCOME. THAT $20,000 OF THIS WILL GO TO A CITYWIDE GUN VIOLENCE PREVENTION AND VICTIMS OF CRIME ASSISTANCE. IS THAT TOO MUCH?

segments.text: I WANT TO SAY AGAIN I'M GOING TO VOTE YES ON THIS. IT'S NOT A PERFECT DOCUMENT. IF WE HAD MORE TIME, THERE ARE MORE THINGS I WOULD EDIT. I JUST WANTED TO EXPLAIN WHY I'M VOTING YES. THE LAST THING I'LL ASK IS THAT THE MAJOR CRITICISM WE HAD FROM THE COMMUNITY WAS THAT THERE WAS NOT ENOUGH TIME TO REVIEW THIS ESPECIALLY THE CHANGES THAT WERE MADE YESTERDAY FOR THIS MORNING. segments.text: THANK YOU. THANK YOU VERY MUCH. THAT CONCLUDES THE ON-AGENDA ITEMS. NEW BUSINESS. MR. SHELBY. GO AHEAD.

segments.text: IF WE CAN, IN RESPONSE COUNCILMAN CARLSON'S REQUEST, I WOULD LIKE THE OPPORTUNITY WITH COUNCIL'S INDULGENCE TO HAVE A BRIEF COLLOQUY WITH HIM TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE THAT HAS BEEN BROUGHT BEFORE COUNCIL. segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: YES.

segments.text: YOU HAVE ABSTAINED IN THE PAST, IS THAT CORRECT?

segments.text: YES, FROM OTHER ISSUES.

segments.text: FROM OTHER ISSUES. WITH REGARD TO THE RAYS' ISSUES, YOU HAVE PARTICIPATED PURSUANT TO FLORIDA STATUTES AND YOU DID VOTE.

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: YES.

segments.text: LET ME ASK, IF I CAN, FOR THOSE WHO ARE NOT FAMILIAR, THE VOTING CONFLICT SECTION, SECTION 112.3143 OF FLORIDA STATUTES. IT REQUIRES SOMEONE, AN ELECTED OFFICIAL MUST ABSTAIN FROM KNOWINGLY VOTING ON A MEASURE THAT WOULD INURE TO THE SPECIAL PRIVATE GAIN OR LOSS OF A PRINCIPAL BY WHOM HE OR SHE IS RETAINED TO THE SPECIAL PRIVATE GAIN OR LOSS OF A RELATIVE OR TO THE SPECIAL PRIVATE GAIN OR LOSS OF A BUSINESS ASSOCIATE. THAT BEING SAID, I'M GOING TO DIRECT YOUR ATTENTION TO THE COMPANY BY WHOM YOU ARE RETAINED. YOU ARE A PRINCIPAL OF THAT COMPANY, CORRECT?

segments.text: I'M ONE OF FIVE SHAREHOLDERS.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: OKAY. IT IS A PUBLIC RELATIONS FIRM.

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: YES.

segments.text: DOES THAT BUSINESS DO BUSINESS WITH THE CITY?

segments.text: NO.

segments.text: NO.

segments.text: DOES IT DO BUSINESS WITH HILLSBOROUGH COLLEGE?

segments.text: NO.

segments.text: DOES IT LOBBY HILLSBOROUGH COLLEGE?

segments.text: NO.

segments.text: DOES IT LOBBY?

segments.text: NO.

segments.text: NO.

segments.text: DOES IT LOBBY ON BEHALF OF THE TAMPA BAY RAYS?

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: NO. WE ALSO DON'T WORK WITH ANY AFFILIATES OF HILLSBOROUGH COLLEGE AND WE DON'T WORK WITH AFFILIATES OF THE RAYS.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: THANK YOU VERY MUCH. THAT BEING SAID -- [ SOUNDING GAVEL ]

segments.text: I ALSO WOULD SAY, LET ME ASK THIS QUESTION, IS IT ILLEGAL OR UNETHICAL TO TAKE CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS FROM SOMETHING THAT WE MAY BE VOTING ON?

segments.text: TWO SEPARATE QUESTIONS.

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: ORGANIZATION MAY BE RELATED --

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: THAT'S TWO SEPARATE QUESTIONS. WHAT YOU DO IS YOU DO RAISE A VERY INTERESTING POINT THAT I DO WANT TO EMPHASIZE. THAT THE VOTING CONFLICT RELATES TO SPECIFICALLY THE MATTER UPON WHICH YOU ARE VOTING. AND THAT'S WHAT IS LOOKED AT AS TO WHETHER A CONFLICT EXISTS AT THE TIME OF THE VOTE. NOT PROSPECTIVELY, NOT IN THE PAST, BUT THE MATTER BEFORE YOU ON THE VOTE. SO THAT BEING SAID, YOUR CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS ARE COVERED BY A TOTALLY SEPARATE CHAPTER OF FLORIDA STATUTES, 104, 106, WHATEVER THE CASE MAY BE, AND CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS DO NOT FACTOR INTO THE ETHICS COMMISSION'S DECISIONS THAT ARE GOVERNED BY OTHER STATUTES OTHER THAN CHAPTER 112. THAT BEING SAID --

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: I SAY THAT BECAUSE MY MAJOR OPPONENT HAS TAKEN -- REPORTED IN THE MEDIA -- $410,000 FROM THE RAYS AND THEIR AFFILIATES. I HAVE TAKEN ZERO IN ANY FORM. [ SOUNDING GAVEL ]

segments.text: CYNTHIA, YOU ARE OUT OF ORDER. IF YOU INTERRUPT AGAIN, I'LL ASK YOU TO LEAVE CHAMBERS.

segments.text: THERE IS A PAY FOR PLAY MEDIA OUTLET. MY FIRM WORKS WITH A LOT OF NONPROFITS, AND WE STARTED A LOT OF NONPROFITS. ONE OF THEM, FOR EXAMPLE, IS CAFE CON TAMPA. THEY ALSO HAVE NOT GIVEN TO ANY OF THE NONPROFITS OR COMPANIES THAT I'M AWARE OF THAT MY FIRM WORKS WITH. BUT WE'VE HELPED START A NUMBER OF NONPROFITS. AND THERE IS A PAY FOR PLAY MEDIA OUTLET THAT'S TRIED TO SMEAR ME RELATED TO ONE OF THE NONPROFITS. AND NONE OF THE NONPROFITS -- I DON'T OPERATE THE NONPROFITS. I'M NOT ON THE BOARD. BUT MY FIRM SUPPORTS MANY NONPROFITS. AND WE'RE SPONSORS OF AND MEMBERS OF MANY ORGANIZATIONS. TO MY KNOWLEDGE -- NOT TO MY KNOWLEDGE, BUT MY FIRM AND I AND MY COLLEAGUES ARE NOT DIRECTLY INVOLVED IN ANYTHING RELATED TO GETTING PAID FOR HILLSBOROUGH COLLEGE OR THE RAYS, AND I'M NOT IN ANY WAY TAKING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS FROM ANY OF THEM. BUT IF I DID, IT'S NOT UNETHICAL, AS YOU JUST SAID. I'VE CHOSEN NOT TO DO IT. I DON'T APPRECIATE BEING ACCUSED OF DOING SOMETHING THAT I HAVEN'T DONE.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: THIS BEING THE CASE, WE TALKED ABOUT YOU AS A PRINCIPAL. LET'S TALK ABOUT ANY RELATIVE. ARE YOU AWARE TO YOUR KNOWLEDGE OF ANY RELATIVE WOULD ANSWER THAT WOULD FIT THAT DEFINITION OF A VOTING CONFLICT, THAT WOULD INURE TO THE SPECIAL PRIVATE GAIN OR LOSS OF ONE OF YOUR RELATIVES?

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: NO.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: LET'S GET TO BUSINESS ASSOCIATE. REFERENCE WAS MADE TO A TRUSTEE AT HILLSBOROUGH COMMUNITY COLLEGE, ARE YOU FAMILIAR WITH THAT.

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: YES.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: THAT TRUSTEE I UNDERSTAND IS -- WELL, LET ME REPHRASE THAT. THAT TRUSTEE WORKS FOR OR WITH THE TAMPA BAY RAYS -- EXCUSE ME, WITHDRAWN. THAT WAS NOT MEANT TO BE SAID. SORRY. WHAT I MEANT TO SAY DOES NOT WORK -- I'M SORRY. I WAS DISTRACTED. NO. MY POINT IS THIS, PLEASE. LET ME SAY IT. WITH REGARD TO THAT TRUSTEE, I WANT TO READ TO YOU THE DEFINITION OF WHAT A BUSINESS ASSOCIATE IS. BECAUSE CONTRARY TO WHAT MAY HAVE BEEN DISCUSSED PUBLICLY, THE TERM BUSINESS ASSOCIATE IS SPECIFICALLY DEFINED IN THE CODE OF ETHICS, WHICH IS WHAT FLORIDA COMMISSION ON ETHICS LOOKS TO WITH REGARD TO A VOTING CONFLICT. I'M GOING TO READ YOU THE DEFINITION AND THEN ASK YOU SOME QUESTIONS. I'M READING FROM CHAPTER 112, 312 OF FLORIDA STATUTES TITLED DEFINITIONS. SUB-4, BUSINESS ASSOCIATE. MEANS ANY PERSON OR ENTITY ENGAGED IN OR CARRYING ON A BUSINESS ENTERPRISE WITH A PUBLIC OFFICER, PUBLIC EMPLOYEE, OR CANDIDATE AS A PARTNER, JOINT VENTURER, CORPORATE SHAREHOLDER WHERE THE SHARES OF THE CORPORATION ARE NOT LISTED ON NATIONAL OR REGIONAL STOCK EXCHANGE OR CO-OWNER OF PROPERTY. I'M GOING TO DIRECT YOUR ATTENTION TO THE PERSON WHO SERVES AS TRUSTEE AT HILLSBOROUGH COLLEGE. WITH REGARD TO YOU AT TUCKER HALL IS THAT PERSON A PARTNER?

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: NO.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: IS THAT PERSON A JOINT VENTURER?

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: NO.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: CORPORATE SHAREHOLDER WHERE THE SHARES OF THE CORPORATION ARE NOT LISTED ON NATIONAL OR REGIONAL STOCK EXCHANGE.

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: NO.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: IS THAT PERSON CO-OWNER OF PROPERTY?

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: NO.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: THEN UNDER SECTION 112312 FOR THE VOTING CONFLICT STATUTE, THAT PERSON IS NOT DEFINED AS A BUSINESS ASSOCIATE. NOW, ALL THESE FACTS BEING SAID, COUNCILMAN CARLSON, ON PREVIOUS VOTES YOU HAVE ASKED MY OPINION AS TO WHETHER A CONFLICT EXISTS, IS THAT CORRECT?

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: YES.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: WELL, I HAVE OFFERED YOU THE OPINION IN PRIVATE AND NOW I HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO TELL YOU MY OPINION PROFESSIONALLY IN PUBLIC. LET ME JUST PUT THIS MATTER TO BED, IF I CAN, PLEASE. segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: OR HILLSBOROUGH COLLEGE.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: OR HILLSBOROUGH COLLEGE, THAT IS CORRECT.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: HONESTLY, THANK YOU, MR. SHELBY, FOR THAT GOOD WORK. NOT JUST FOR A SINGLE MEMBER OF COUNCIL, BUT FOR ALL OF US, I THINK IT'S A GOOD REMINDER FOR US ALL WHAT THE STATUTE IS. I APPRECIATE YOU DOING YOUR HOME WORK --

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: CAN I MAKE ONE MORE? JUST TO WRAP THIS UP, ONE OF THE REASONS I RAN FOR OFFICE IS TO BRING ETHICS BACK TO THE CITY BECAUSE I WAS UNHAPPY ABOUT SOME OF THE ETHICAL THINGS THAT WERE HAPPENING HERE. WHEN I FIRST JOINED THE CITY, MARTY AND I WENT TO THE COMMISSION ON ETHICS AND GOT AN OPINION ON WHAT MY FIRM CAN AND CAN'T DO. MY FELLOW SHAREHOLDERS HAVE MADE HUGE FINANCIAL SACRIFICES OVER THE LAST EIGHT YEARS BECAUSE WE HAVE PREEMPTIVELY RECUSED OURSELVES FROM PROJECTS AND NOT TAKEN ON CLIENTS AND EVEN FIRED CLIENTS THAT WE THOUGHT MAY POTENTIALLY HAVE A CONFLICT. I HOLD MYSELF AND MY FIRM TO THE HIGHEST ETHICAL STANDARDS. I APPRECIATE THE PUBLIC ASKING QUESTIONS. BUT IF SOMEBODY HAS A QUESTION, PLEASE ASK ME. BUT NOW WE'VE ANSWERED THE QUESTION AND I WOULD APPRECIATE NOT CONTINUING WITH THIS. IF ANYBODY IN THE PUBLIC WANTS TO HAVE A CONSTRUCTIVE CONVERSATION, DIALOGUE ABOUT HILLSBOROUGH COLLEGE AND HOW TO PROTECT THE FACULTY AND STUDENTS IN THE COMMUNITY, I'M HAPPY TO HAVE THAT CONVERSATION. I JUST DON'T LIKE BEING SLANDERED. THANK YOU.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: COUNCILMAN VIERA.

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: THANK YOU VERY MUCH, SIR. A COUPLE OF THINGS, I TOOK MR. SHELBY OUTSIDE TO EXPRESS SOME CONCERNS, WHICH IS WE NEED TO HAVE UNIVERSAL RULES TO NOT PUT OUR CHAIRMAN IN A BAD POSITION ON CITATION OF COUNCIL MEMBERS. I'M NOT GOING TO MOTION FOR THAT, BUT COUNCIL MEMBERS, WE NEED TO TAKE CARE OF THAT BECAUSE WE'RE GOING TO GET IN TROUBLE. IT'S ALL I'M GOING TO SAY. THERE'S GOT TO BE UNIVERSAL RULES ON THAT.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: WE HAVE THE RULE. IT HAS TO BE UNIVERSALLY APPLIED.

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: YEAH, IN OTHER WORDS IF SOMEBODY GOES UP THERE AND SAYS LUIS VIERA WALKS ON WATER, LET'S GO GIVE HIM A KEY TO THE CITY. I'M NOT GOING TO OBJECT. WE PUT YOU, SIR, IN A BAD POSITION. I JUST THINK WE NEED TO DO SOMETHING OF THAT NATURE, I WOULD SAY.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: I AGREE ON THAT. I'VE PROBABLY BEEN A LITTLE TOO RELAXED ON THAT AS WELL BECAUSE OF THAT OPEN DIALOGUE STUFF. HONESTLY, ESPECIALLY WITH THE REALLY MEATY ISSUES, I THINK WE'RE JUST GOING TO HAVE TO PULL IT BACK A LITTLE MORE THAN WE HAVE IN THE PAST.

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: ADMISSION ON MY PART BECAUSE I'M NOT JUDGING ANYBODY, SEVEN YEARS AGO SOMEBODY CALLED ME OUT. I SAID I THINK GUIDO WAS THE CHAIR. OBJECTION, YOU CAN'T -- IT WAS BECAUSE HE WAS SAYING SOMETHING NEGATIVE. I'M NOT JUDGING --

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: I DON'T KNOW ALLOW THE CLAPS BECAUSE I DON'T ALLOW THE BOOS. SAME KIND OF THING. NEW BUSINESS, COUNCILMAN CARLSON, ANY NEW BUSINESS? COUNCILMAN VIERA, I KNOW YOU DO.

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: I HAVE A COUPLE, IF I MAY. I'M GOING TO MAKE THE MOTION. I DON'T HAVE THE CALENDAR HERE WITH ME. I APOLOGIZE. segments.text: DO WE HAVE A DATE?
